# Discords.com

> > Discords.com is a comprehensive directory and resource hub for Discord server templates, enabling users to discover and deploy pre-configured community and gaming server setups.

The platform serves as a centralized marketplace for Discord server templates spanning gaming communities (FiveM, PUBG, BLOXFRUITS, GPO), roleplay servers (LSPD, SAHP), and various community types. Discords.com helps server administrators quickly launch structured Discord communities using battle-tested templates.

## Key Topics

- Discord server templates
- Community templates
- Gaming server templates
- FiveM roleplay servers
- Discord server setup
- Template directory
- LSPD and SAHP templates
- PUBG gaming communities
- BLOXFRUITS and GPO servers
- Server configuration tools
- Discord community building
- Pre-configured server structures
- Revolutionary Studios templates
- NodeLaps integrations

## Discord Server Templates

- [Discord Server Templates | Discord Template List | Discords.com](https://discords.com/templates/?rsd): Browse Discord server templates to build communities and gaming servers
